messages.initial: How can I assist you today?

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Your device looks offline. Check the connection and try again.

rate_limit.title: Too many questions
rate_limit.body: The assistant hit its request limit. Give it a minute and ask again.

auth.title: Assistant unavailable
auth.body: The assistant is not set up correctly on the server. This one is on us, not on you.

timeout.title: Took too long
timeout.body: The answer did not arrive in time. Trying again usually works.

upstream.title: Assistant unreachable
upstream.body: We could not reach the assistant. It may be a blip, so try again in a moment.

unknown.title: Something broke
unknown.body: The answer could not be generated. Your question is still here, so you can retry it.

suggestions.title: Try asking:
suggestions.subtitle: Click on any suggestion to get started

openIn.label: Open in
openIn.prompt: Explain the content of this page: {page}. Context: {url}. Explain when to use it, why to use it, best practices, and alternatives based on the documentation provided. It could be a page about components, tools, libraries, concepts, etc. Do not provide unnecessary information. ALWAYS based on the documentation provided.

githubStar.tocSubtitle: Star on GitHub helps me a lot

landingLogoCta.line2: Readable by you and your agent.
landingLogoCta.description: The CLI writes the component straight into your project. From that point on it is your file: no wrapper package, no upstream release to wait for, and nothing hidden from the AI agent editing it next to you.
landingLogoCta.outputNote: One file per component, in the path your nachui.json points to.

issueCta.question: Found something to improve?
issueCta.description: Notice a bug, typo, or missing detail on this page? Help us make the documentation better by opening a GitHub issue.
